hierarchyPlusRebone.title: Hierarchy Plus Rebone
hierarchyPlusRebone.copy: A Unity editor tool that makes the Hierarchy easier to read and manage. It adds row styling, guide lines, component icons, and Tag / Layer labels so large avatar hierarchies and complex scenes can be parsed more quickly.

cards.title: Best For
cards.body: Complex VRChat avatar hierarchies, large scenes, and workflows where component state and object labels need to be checked constantly.

cards.title: Hierarchy Visibility
cards.body: Uses row color, guide lines, icons, and labels to make hierarchy depth and object state easier to scan.

cards.title: Reworked Fork
cards.body: Based on the no-longer-maintained original HierarchyPlus, rebuilt to respect the original license and fit modern Unity plus VPM / VCC packaging.

meta.body: This is an editor-only extension and does not affect runtime builds. It is organized for Unity 2022.3+ and VPM / VCC package workflows.

sections.title: Key Features
items: Adds row colors, background styling, and guide lines to the Hierarchy for easier structural scanning.
Makes parent / child depth easier to read through indentation and guide line rendering.
Displays GameObject and component icons on the right side of the Hierarchy.
Supports icon clicks and drag-toggle behavior for quickly enabling or disabling objects and some components.
Shows Tag and Layer labels and supports quick context-based editing.
Lets you hide selected icon types through Hidden Types rules.
Stores custom styling such as icon tint, inactive tint, guide color, and row background color.

sections.title: Requirements
items: Unity 2022.3 or newer
VCC or VPM package management workflow
Editor-only usage
No runtime dependency

sections.title: Basic Usage
items: Install the package through VCC or VPM.
Open Iyan-Kim > Tools > Hierarchy Plus Rebone.
Enable the HierarchyPlus Enabled option.
Configure the Colors, Components, and Labels sections as needed.
Changes are reflected immediately in the Hierarchy window.
Use Refresh Icons if the icon cache does not update correctly.

entries.title: HierarchyPlus Enabled / Colors
entries.body: Turns the full feature set on or off and lets you configure row colors, guide lines, icon backgrounds, and active or inactive icon tint.

entries.title: Guide Lines / Row Coloring
entries.body: Renders structural guide lines for parent / child relationships and alternates row backgrounds to improve readability in long hierarchies.

entries.title: Components / Drag-Toggle
entries.body: Shows GameObject and component icons in the Hierarchy and lets you use context menus or drag-toggle interaction for fast state changes.

entries.title: Labels / Context Click
entries.body: Displays Tag and Layer labels and supports quick value changes through label context actions.

entries.title: Hidden Types / Refresh Icons
entries.body: Lets you hide specific component icon types and refresh the icon cache if rendering gets out of sync.

sections.title: Tips
items: Guide Lines plus Row Coloring work especially well for complex VRChat avatar hierarchies.
If you often inspect component-heavy objects, enable the Components block so the Hierarchy becomes a quick status dashboard.
If Tag or Layer changes are frequent, Labels with context click support will save time.
Use Hidden Types to reduce visual noise when too many icons appear at once.
Avoid running the original HierarchyPlus side by side with this version, because both may try to modify the same editor surface.

entries.title: Nothing changes in the Hierarchy
entries.body: Make sure HierarchyPlus Enabled is on, click back into the Hierarchy window, and try Refresh Icons if needed.

entries.title: Component icons are missing
entries.body: Check the Components block and the Show GameObject Icon, Show Transform Icon, and Show Non-Toggleable Icons options. Also verify Hidden Types is not filtering them out.

entries.title: Tag or Layer labels are missing
entries.body: Check that Labels, Show Layer Label, and Show Tag Label are enabled, and that default Layer / Untagged entries are not hidden.

entries.title: Icons or colors overlap visually
entries.body: Adjust Icons X Offset, review Always Render Icons or background options, and widen the Hierarchy window if necessary.

entries.title: It conflicts with the original HierarchyPlus
entries.body: This version changes namespaces and menu paths to reduce collisions, but running two Hierarchy extensions at the same time can still produce overlapping output.

entries.title: Base Project
entries.body: Hierarchy Plus Rebone is a modified and reorganized project based on the original HierarchyPlus. The original project was created by DreadScripts and this version was reworked by Iyan-Kim.

entries.title: License
entries.body: It keeps the GNU General Public License v3.0 or later from the original project. Redistribution must preserve the same license terms and associated notice obligations.

entries.title: Package Direction
entries.body: This package preserves the original license, clearly marks itself as a modified version, and reorganizes package layout, namespace, menu path, asmdef structure, and Unity 2022.3+ compatibility for VPM / VCC distribution.

Standardized the package display name as `Iyan-Kim Hierarchy Plus Rebone`.
Updated package description and metadata for the current distribution format.
Declared the license as `GPL-3.0-or-later`.
Reorganized the VPM / VCC package layout.

Cleaned up package distribution metadata.
Performed maintenance work for repository registration and VPM distribution stability.
No functional changes.

Reorganized package structure for Unity 2022.3+.
Improved the editor-only asmdef setup.
Adjusted namespaces to reduce conflicts with the original HierarchyPlus.

Aligned the menu path with the Iyan-Kim tool structure.
Updated the settings window name and PRODUCT_NAME to `Hierarchy Plus Rebone`.
Cleaned up internal file structure for VPM package distribution.

Refactored the original HierarchyPlus code for a modern Unity package structure.
Reorganized saved settings, styling, content, indentation, and color-processing classes inside the package layout.
Separated editor-only code more clearly.

Moved the original HierarchyPlus-based functionality into the Rebone project structure.
Reorganized namespaces and file layout.
Added the initial VPM package configuration.

Initial release.
Started the Hierarchy Plus Rebone project based on the original HierarchyPlus.
Included row colors, guide lines, component icons, and Tag / Layer label support for the Unity Hierarchy.
Prepared the project for modification and redistribution under GPL-3.0.
